text:
```yaml
name: Lychee

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  check-links:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check links with Lychee
        uses: lycheeverse/lychee-action@v2
        with:
          args: "--verbose"
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          fail: true
          failIfEmpty: false
          workingDirectory: .
```
